calls.reason: No independent source confirms the August 2025 figure of 8M active licensed users. Microsoft's disclosures cover all Copilot apps or later paid seats (15M in Jan 2026), so they neither confirm nor refute it.

PitchBook reports $4.63T of global private-capital dry powder at end of Q2 2025, and S&P reports $2.5T for private equity alone. Both far exceed $325B, and so does Zitron's own top-10 firm tally of about $477B.
NVIDIA posts show that non-AI GPU uses exist, such as molecular dynamics and cryptography. They give no counts or revenue, so the packet cannot settle whether such uses are few or commercially small.
There is no user-level revenue or serving-cost data. Anthropic's API spend limits are customer-side controls and do not settle provider profitability per user.
Huang said NVIDIA finalized a $30B investment and that $100B is 'probably not in the cards', which points to the original $100B not being delivered. The 90% gating explanation itself is unconfirmed.
The Stanford/ADP work finds weaker early-career employment in AI-exposed jobs, consistent with an AI effect, but its authors call it descriptive rather than causal. Evidence is mixed either way.
